style: Say playfully and cheerfully, like a fun music teacher
lines: This is Kip. Kip is a robot that learns from examples. Tap Next pet to show Kip a pet.
Is it a cat or a dog? Say it out loud. Then tap Cat or Dog.
Kip remembers: that one is a cat!
Kip remembers: that one is a dog!
Now tap Mystery pet. Kip will guess!
What will Kip guess? Say it out loud!
Kip looks for the pet it remembers that looks the most alike.
Kip thinks it's a cat!
Kip thinks it's a dog!
Yes! Kip got it right!
Oops! Kip guessed wrong. Kip needs more examples.
Oops! Kip remembered that pet wrong.
Tap Mystery pet again, or Next pet to teach Kip more.
Tap Mystery pet again, or Pet Parade to count.
Kip doesn't remember any pets yet. Tap Next pet first!
Kip doesn't remember any pets yet. Tap Teach first!
That's every example card! Tap Pet Parade to see how Kip does.
Tap Forget to make Kip forget this pet. Tap the card again to keep it.
Kip forgot that one.
Tap Next pet to show it to Kip again.
Starting over! Kip's memory is empty.
Tap Next pet to show Kip a pet.
Welcome to the Pet Parade! Ten new pets will walk by. Count how many Kip gets right.
Tap Start parade.
Kip got zero out of ten right.
Kip got one out of ten right.
Kip got two out of ten right.
Kip got three out of ten right.
Kip got four out of ten right.
Kip got five out of ten right.
Kip got six out of ten right.
Kip got seven out of ten right.
Kip got eight out of ten right.
Kip got nine out of ten right.
Kip got ten out of ten right!
That's more than last time!
That's the same as last time.
That's fewer than last time. Did Kip learn something wrong?
Tap Teach and show Kip more pets. Then run the parade again.
Kip has seen every pet! Tap Teach to try Mystery pets, or Start over to teach Kip again.
The more different pets Kip saw, the better Kip guessed!
